title: Junior Data Engineer – London, Glasgow
description:
At mthree, we connect talented graduates with top tier organizations, including leading investment banks and companies across insurance, travel, and more. We currently have a Data Engineer role with a leading financial company.

Overview

We are seeking a Data Engineer to design, build and maintain scalable cloud-native data pipelines that transform data into trusted, AI-ready datasets. The role will focus on data modelling, curation, governance and the delivery of high-quality datasets that support analytics, AI and business decision-making.

Location: London or Glasgow - 5 days onsite

Responsibilities

  • Support the development and maintenance of cloud-based data pipelines using modern data engineering practices.
  • Work with the team to ingest, transform and deliver data from a variety of vendor and market data sources.
  • Help build and maintain reliable, accurate and accessible datasets for internal users and applications.
  • Assist with developing data models and data structures to support new datasets and business requirements.
  • Work with large datasets and learn how to build solutions that can process and manage data at scale.
  • Support the implementation of data quality checks, monitoring and governance processes.
  • Help prepare AI-ready and analytics-ready datasets for use by internal teams and applications.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, performance and reliability, working closely with more experienced engineers.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, analytics, product and governance teams to understand requirements and deliver data solutions.
  • Learn and apply best practices in data engineering, cloud technologies and data management as part of the role.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a closely related subject.
  • Good understanding of data engineering concepts, including data pipelines, data transformation and data management.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in working with large datasets.
  • Understanding of databases and SQL.
  • Experience with Databricks or Snowflake is highly desirable, but not essential.
  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn new technologies.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.
  • Any industry placement, internship or project experience in data engineering, data analytics or data science would be an advantage.

 

 

How to Apply

  1. Apply via the form below.
  2. Engage in video interviews with our friendly talent team (30 min video call)
  3. Tech assessment
  4. Interview directly with our client

 

Diversity and Inclusion at mthree

At mthree, we celebrate diversity and foster an environment where everyone can thrive. We value inclusion, equality, and the health and well-being of all employees, ensuring our culture supports courageous teamwork, continuous learning, and making an impact.
